parameters.name: Procore-Company-Id
parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

parameters.name: segment_id
parameters.description: ID of the WBS Segment whose Segment Item Lists to retrieve. Only cost_code and line_item_type segment types are supported; other segment types return an empty array. Retrieve valid segment IDs from segments[].id in the GET patterns response.

get.summary: List Company WBS Segment Item Lists
get.description: List Segment Item Lists for a specific segment

items.description: A WBS Segment Item List — a named collection of segment items (cost codes or cost types) that can be assigned to a WBS Segment. For cost_code segments this corresponds to a Standard Cost Code List; for line_item_type segments these are fixed system lists (Procore Cost Types and, when ERP-integrated, ERP Cost Types).

id.description: Unique identifier for this Segment Item List. For cost_code segments, this is the Standard Cost Code List ID. For line_item_type segments, 1 = Procore Cost Types (non-ERP) and 2 = ERP Cost Types.

name.description: Display name of the Segment Item List (e.g. 'Procore Standard Cost Codes' or 'Procore Cost Types'). Shown in the WBS Admin UI when selecting a list for a segment.

segment_items_count.description: Total number of segment items (cost codes or cost types) contained in this list.

erp_integrated.description: Whether this list is linked to an ERP integration. When true, the segment items in this list are managed by the connected ERP system and cannot be freely edited in Procore.

available_to_use_on_new_projects.description: Whether this list is available to be assigned to new projects. When true, it can be selected during project creation or project-level WBS configuration.

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/work_breakdown_structure/segments/%7Bsegment_id%7D/lists")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
